test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

abandon
solution:
The correct answer is **leave**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abandon: **to leave somebody/something that you are responsible for, usually permanently.
 
• **Leave: **to go away from somebody/something.
 
• Thus, the correct synonym of **'****abandon' **is **'****leave'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Start: **to begin doing something.
 
• **Adopt: **to take and use something.
 
• **Allow: **to give permission for somebody/something to do something or for something to happen.
